title: Personal Loans Standing and the Credit Builder Accounts Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief
content:
The relief share of the early-closure late-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the borrower also holds a Larkspur personal loan. The loans are the borrower's Personal Loans, read from the borrower's loan records: each loan's status and its amount past due.

## Standing of the borrower's loans

When the borrower holds a Larkspur personal loan in active status with no amount past due, the current-loan addition is added; when every active Larkspur personal loan of the borrower shows an amount past due, the past-due-loan addition; when the borrower holds no active Larkspur personal loan, nothing is added for a loan.

| Borrower's Personal Loans in active status | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| at least one with an amount past due of 0.00 | current-loan addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| one or more, every one showing an amount past due | past-due-loan addition: 0.02 (2 percentage points) |
| none (no loan, or loans only in other statuses) | nothing |

## Questions the rule answers

**A borrower has two active personal loans, one current and one 50.00 past due. Which addition applies?** The current-loan addition of 5 percentage points: the borrower holds an active personal loan with no amount past due.

**A borrower's only personal loan is no longer in active status. Which addition applies?** None: the borrower holds no active Larkspur personal loan.
